temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal matters and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable, and Carolyn has no clear explanation for her recent withdrawal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn learns that Marilyn's quietness is likely due to work and personal stress, not simply disinterest or ordinary behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues and may need support or someone to talk to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Check in on Marilyn, offer support, and leave the door open for her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: In a later interaction, Marilyn is curt, which confuses and slightly hurts Carolyn. When Carolyn apologizes for possibly overstepping and shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes for seeming off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the first conversation, Carolyn believed Marilyn was overwhelmed but receptive to Carolyn's concern; she may have expected their interactions to remain supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's curtness makes Carolyn doubt whether she overstepped, but Marilyn's explanation reframes the behavior as stress-related rather than personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn has had a hard week and appreciates Carolyn's support; her curtness was not meant as a rejection.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up any misunderstanding, show support, and maintain a positive relationship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appears to respond positively to Carolyn's earlier openness; when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn thanks her and enthusiastically accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful that she and Marilyn are developing a friendship, though she still sees it as budding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's acceptance of the social invitation reinforces that she is open to a friendship beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is willing to socialize and build a friendship with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen their bond and connect with Marilyn at the gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed her friendship with Marilyn was growing, especially after the invitation was accepted, and may have expected more warmth or closeness in their work interactions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn learns that the perceived distance may be unintentional or related to professional conduct, and Marilyn is willing to discuss and improve it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a work dynamic to address, but Marilyn is not deliberately rejecting Carolyn and is open to improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously optimistic after Marilyn's response.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the perceived distance directly and work toward a better professional dynamic with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Following the previous conversation, Carolyn feels content and optimistic that she and Marilyn have resolved their work-dynamic issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms that the repaired understanding can translate into a collaborative partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn understand each other better and can work together positively on the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Collaborate with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
